purpose: ATH on the first bar (IPO-peak secular decline): tA=0 is a valid anchor and a descending envelope line forms from t=0.
category: normal valid variant (ATH on first bar)

rejection_rationale.rejected_because: Its steeper line passes below the t=10 pivot high (150), which pierces beyond eps -> not envelope-valid.

rejection_rationale.candidate: tA!=0 (treating t=0 as not-anchorable because it cannot be a k=3 confirmed pivot)
rejection_rationale.rejected_because: The ATH bar is an anchor by construction regardless of pivot confirmation (§5, §18 ATH-on-first-bar).
rejection_rationale.numeric: HA=max H[t]=200 at t=0 (unique global max); anchor A=(0,200) accepted.

key_inequalities: Pivots below ATH: t=5 (170) and t=10 (150), both k=3 confirmed.
Only (10,150) dominates every intervening high within eps; (5,170) fails on t=10.
geometry_check.notes: Demonstrates the §18 'ATH on the first bar' edge case resolves to a normal valid line, not an error.
